## Data wrangling

```{r}
#| label: load-data

#Read in the data
 air <- read.csv("raw-data/air-pollution(air-pollution).csv", skip = 3)
 climate <- read.csv("raw-data/climate-change.csv", skip = 3)
 co2 <- read.csv("raw-data/co2-emissions(co2-emissions).csv", skip = 4)
 
#assigned the names of the first row to row names
air <- air|>
  row_to_names(row_number = 1)
climate <- climate|>
  row_to_names(row_number = 1)
 
```
 

```{r}
#| label: climate-data

#removed an unnecessary column
climate <- climate |>
  select(-"Indicator Code")

#created a vector with variables of interest
variables<- c("Renewable energy consumption (% of total final energy consumption)", 
              "Electricity production from oil sources (% of total)",
              "Electricity production from coal sources (% of total)",
              "Renewable electricity output (% of total electricity output)",
              "Population growth (annual %)", 
              "Forest area (% of land area)")
#filtered observations with variables of interest
climate <- climate |>
  filter(`Indicator Name` %in% variables)
```  

```{r}
#| label: co2-data

#Load country-data from rnaturalearth and select relevant columns
region <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf") |>
  #Replace missing country codes (Norway and France)
  mutate(iso_a3 = ifelse(iso_a3 == "-99", iso_a3_eh, iso_a3)) |>  
  select(iso_a3, region_un, sovereignt) |>  #UN region classification
  rename(`Country Code` = iso_a3, `Country Name` = sovereignt)

#Merging existing dataset with the region data and coordinates for plotting
co2_cleaned <- co2 |> 
  

  # 3) Remove "X" from the year columns
  rename_with(.cols = matches("^X(19|20)\\d{2}$"), 
              .fn   = ~ sub("^X", "", .x)) |> 
  # 4) Convert all year columns to numeric
  mutate(across(matches("^(19|20)\\d{2}$"), as.numeric)) |> 
  # 5) Pivot longer: create one row per Year and Value
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = matches("^(19|20)\\d{2}$"),
    names_to  = "Year",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) |> 
  # 6) Pivot wider: separate columns for each Indicator.Name
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Indicator.Name,
    values_from = Value
  ) |> 
  rename(co2conc = `Carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions (total) excluding LULUCF (% change from 1990)`, "Country Code" = `Country.Code`) |> 
  filter(co2conc < 500) |> 
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))

co2_map <- left_join(region, co2_cleaned, by = "Country Code")

```
